title: Autumn Sparkle Vanity Top Soap Dispenser - 7-Inch H Countertop Solid Brass, 5 Oz Bottle - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep your bathroom vanity neat and coordinated while upgrading your sink area with a solid brass vanity top soap dispenser — available in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, it’s designed for everyday use with a generous 5 ounce bottle for soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer.

  • Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose a finish that fits your bathroom—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
  • Built to last—solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Keep refills simple with the included 5 oz bottle

Specs

  • Product type: Vanity top soap dispenser (countertop)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in x 7 in x 5 in
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Capacity: 5 oz bottle
  • Material: Brass (solid brass)
  • Weight capacity: 5 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Soap dispenser
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection for a cohesive set of transitional bath accessories and grooved bathroom hardware.
meta_description: Vanity top soap dispenser with 5 oz bottle in solid brass. 7-inch H countertop dispenser for bathroom soap or lotion, backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
